﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: asto-core v1.13.0 -> v1.14.1

## Context

Project `docker-adapter` (by artipie) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`com.artipie:asto-core` from `v1.13.0` to `v1.14.1` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/artipie/docker-adapter/pull/536

## Your Task

The source code is in `/docker-adapter`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the compilation errors and then fix them.

In hamcrest 2.x, you use `containsString(String)` instead of `new StringContains(...)`. For case-insensitive matching, there's `containsStringIgnoringCase(String)`.
